title: Member Tenure Discount on LandlordGuard Term Pay-Offs
content:
Larkspur Mutual discounts the pay-off of a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy term for members of long standing on the building. The pay-off tenure discount looks at whole months from the original effective date to the pay-off date: 120 months or more give 2 percent; 60 to 119 months give 1 percent; fewer than 60 months give 0 percent. The discount is taken off the pay-off percentage, which is applied once to the unbilled premium of the current term.

The original effective date is the policy's first inception date on the building; renewals do not restart it, and only completed months count.

Two hypothetical members paying off on 5 May 2025 show the upper edge: a policy first effective on 5 May 2015 has 120 whole months and takes 2 percent, while one first effective a day later, on 6 May 2015, has 119 whole months and takes 1 percent. The lower edge sits at 60 months: first effective on 5 May 2020 gives 60 whole months and 1 percent, and 6 May 2020 gives 59 whole months and no discount.

| Whole months to the pay-off date | 120 or more | 60 to 119 | fewer than 60 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay-off tenure discount | 2 percent | 1 percent | 0 percent |
